title: Settings: Your Controls and Test-Mode Limits
tagline: Take charge of your experience with calm, clear controls made for you.
audience: everyday users who want control without fear
objectives: Understand where to find and manage your Settings
Customize your profile display and notification preferences
Set cap and low-balance warning thresholds for gentle alerts
Recognize test-mode limits and sign out safely

analogy.title: Your Home Control Panel
analogy.story: Think of Settings like the control panel in your home. The thermostat lets you set the perfect temperature, light switches choose brightness, and labels on the fuse box show what each switch does. Settings works the same way for your app. You adjust how your profile looks, choose when to be notified, and set alert levels for caps and balances. Test-mode is like a clearly marked practice switch, so you always know what is simulated and what is real.

mapping.everydayThing: Thermostat safety alerts and a clearly labeled practice switch

pitch30Seconds: Welcome to Settings, your personal control panel. In about five minutes, you’ll learn how to update your display name, choose which notifications you receive, and set helpful warnings for caps and low balances. You’ll also see how test-mode keeps you safe — everything here is practice with no real money, and your data stays private and secure. By the end, you’ll feel confident adjusting your controls anytime you want.

coreIdeas.plainWords: Your display name and avatar personalize your account. It is visible only to you and helps you recognize your own workspace quickly.
Choose which updates you receive, such as alerts and reminders. You can turn notifications on or off anytime to match your preferences.
Set a cap to limit practice spending and a low-balance warning to know when funds get low. These gentle alerts keep you aware without worry.
Test-mode means everything is simulated with no real money or real provider actions. Your data is row-level-secured. Sign out safely when you finish on shared devices.

howItWorks: Open Settings from the main menu to see all your controls in one calm place.
Update your profile display and choose which notifications you want to receive.
Set your cap and low-balance warning levels to get timely, friendly alerts.
Read the test-mode notice to confirm you are in practice mode with no real money.
Sign out safely when using a shared device to keep your private account secure.

recallQuiz.question: Where do you change your alert and notification preferences?
choices: In Settings under Notifications and warning levels
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: Settings holds all alert controls, so you can adjust notifications and thresholds anytime in one place.

recallQuiz.question: What does test-mode mean?
choices: Everything is simulated with no real money and no real provider actions
You are spending real money instantly
You are contacting a live provider
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: Test-mode is practice-only, so you can learn safely with no real money at risk.

recallQuiz.question: Who can see your private account data?
choices: Only you, it is row-level-secured to your account
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: Your account is row-level-secured, so your information stays private and visible only to you.

safetyNote: Your private account is row-level-secured, so only you can see your data. This is test-mode with no real money involved, and all Settings are designed to be mobile-friendly for easy use on any device.
tryIt: Open the Settings screen, update your display name, toggle one notification on and off, and set your low-balance warning to a level that feels comfortable.
